tiers.name: NEON preferential-flow event database / Li et al. 2025
observations: event-based PF classifications via non-sequential response and velocity threshold
antecedent mean and variability of soil moisture
tiers.access: Open NEON source data; derived PF database and analysis code publicly available
tiers.strength: Best broad event-level discriminator for activation timing and state/intensity dependence
tiers.limitation: Not a controlled single-soil laboratory experiment; structural parameters vary among sites

tiers.name: Hartmann et al. 2022 Griessfirn Brilliant Blue irrigation series
observations: five excavated vertical profiles per subplot
dye-derived flow-path morphology and depth distributions
tiers.access: Paper tables downloadable; soil structure/texture repository open; Brilliant Blue images available from authors
tiers.strength: Controlled intensity perturbation on the same plots/profile classes
tiers.limitation: Antecedent moisture is not the main controlled factor; image data may require author request

tiers.name: Hardie et al. antecedent-moisture dye experiment
observations: high versus low antecedent soil moisture
tiers.access: Published article; raw open dataset not confirmed

tiers.name: Wuestebach multi-depth soil-moisture PF monitoring
tiers.strength: Same catchment, many events, direct non-sequential response classification
tiers.limitation: The public record found may primarily expose publication-level material rather than the full processed event table

tiers.name: WUR rainfall-simulator/macropore experiments 2016
tiers.strength: Direct WUR macropore experiment and breakthrough observations
tiers.limitation: Not designed as a systematic antecedent-moisture/intensity transferability experiment

decision_order: Use NEON-derived event database first for activation occurrence/timing statistics.
Use Hartmann intensity series for controlled intensity and connectivity-depth signatures.
Use Hardie published contrast as a strong antecedent-state falsification benchmark and pursue raw data if needed.
Only after these screens calibrate or reject sigma_B; do not retune geometry event by event.
